text_block_list.text:
A certain afternoon, not long before the 
Kyodo News Hai—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Oh, it's open.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is here okay?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, CB. Eating at the cafeteria today, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Every now and then, I get this crazy 
craving for the Cobb salad here.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, I've never tried that before. Maybe 
I'll give it a try next time."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Also, I'm entering the upcoming Kyodo News 
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heh~, the "Kyodo News Hai", huh? Maybe 
I'll run in it next time—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you startled me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That's my line! The Kyodo News Hai!? This 
is the first I've heard of it!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, that's because this is the 
first time I've said it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa...! What was that all of 
a sudden—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Because that place seems likely to 
produce strong ones, you see.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you for the food!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you were that hungry?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Thank you for the meal!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for telling me, CB.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Which one are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Both of them!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me run in the Kyodo News Hai!! 
I'm begging you!!

After calming Katsuragi Ace down for the 
moment, I asked her what happened—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—And so, it seems CB is going to run in 
the Kyodo News Hai...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I... When she said 'Because strong 
opponents will probably show up,' I lost 
my temper and—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Because that's like...! That's basically 
like telling me that I'm not strong to 
her...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...It's true that there might still be a 
gap in our abilities. However—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Just nodding along and letting it slide 
like that is completely wrong……!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, even if it's last minute, I... I 
want to run in the Kyodo News Hai...!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —I want to race against C.B.!!

"...If we move as fast as possible right 
now, she should just barely be able to 
run."

And with Katsuragi Ace's current 
abilities, she had a very real chance of 
running well in this race. However—

—To be honest, how well the current 
Katsuragi Ace can fight against Mr. C.B. 
is still largely an unknown variable...

Even so, if Katsuragi Ace keeps climbing 
the ranks of the Twinkle Series, facing 
each other is bound to happen eventually.

"...Then there's no use fearing it. 
Rather, facing them now should be seen as 
a stepping stone to even greater 
heights...!"
choice_data_list:
—Understood. Let's enter the Kyodo News 
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Hell yeah! That's what I'm talkin' about!

And so, having hastily decided to run in 
the Kyodo News Hai, we rushed to make 
adjustments—

—And then, the day of the Kyodo News Hai 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. This paddock is intense as 
hell...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (The reason why is obvious――)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Hey there, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(As I thought, she's in a league of her 
own...! What an insane presence...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Still――like hell I'm gonna let it swallow 
me up!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Let's make it a good race.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to tell me twice. Let's 
settle this, C.B.!!
